summary: Tested all 4 fixes from this session (stop-loss reactive retry, news temperature-strength flame, news auto-load 3/5+ panel, Trading multi-chart stuck-loading fix). All verified working via backend code review + pytest unit tests + live curl + Playwright E2E on the real preview URL with actual login (daniel.r.millner@gmail.com). No regressions found. 15/15 backend pytest tests passed (5 new tests added for the reactive force-cancel-retry logic). Live manual BUY->SELL round trip on AAPL succeeded with 200 status, no 409/500, position closed cleanly. GET /api/news/{symbol} confirmed temperature field correctly derived from score/sentiment (score>=10->hot, 5-9->medium, 2-4->cold, 0->null) across AAPL/TSLA/NVDA/AMD. Scanner scan confirmed news_temperature field present on rows; verified rows with confirmed news correctly tie to strict min_score=10 catalyst bar (temperature always 'hot' when has_positive_news is from a verified check - unverified estimate-only rows correctly show news_temperature=null, this is pre-existing/unrelated scanner second-pass-only-verifies-top-50 behavior, not a regression). Dashboard NewsFeedPanel auto-load feature (FEATURE 3) fully confirmed live: with no symbol selected and 6 candidates at 3/5+, header showed 'NEWS - 6 STOCKS @ 3/5+' with per-article symbol tags and correct orange MOMENTUM flame vs no-flame neutral articles; clicking a scanner row (ADVB) switched cleanly to 'NEWS - ADVB' single-symbol mode with symbol tags removed. Trading page multi-chart view (BUG FIX 4): selected 3 stocks (ADVB, LVLU, ZYBT), all 3 loaded real charts within ~4s (console confirmed successful fetches), no chart got stuck on chart-loading-{symbol} testid; deselect->reselect cycle also worked correctly with a fresh transient loading state that cleared within 8s.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIX 1 (_sell_with_dedup reactive retry): code review confirms 'insufficient qty' substring check correctly matches Alpaca's real error wording ('insufficient qty available for order (requested: X, available: Y)', verified via web search). The new try/except wraps ONLY the final place_market_order call and does not touch the pre-existing fresh/stale pre-check logic above it. Unrelated exceptions (e.g. 'insufficient buying power') correctly re-raise via `if 'insufficient qty' not in str(e).lower(): raise`. Only sell-side resting orders are force-cancelled (verified in new unit test), buy orders untouched. A second failure on retry correctly propagates (no infinite loop/swallow). Added 4 new deterministic pytest unit tests covering all these paths - all pass.

FEATURE 2 (news temperature): google_news_service.score_headline() and scanner_service.check_alpaca_news()/google_news_service.search_stock_news() consistently derive temperature from sentiment tier (strong_catalyst->hot, momentum->medium, weak->cold, neutral->null), independent of article age (classify_freshness kept separate). Live curl across 4 symbols showed zero inconsistencies between score/sentiment/temperature. Frontend ScannerCells.NewsFlame and NewsFeedPanel.js both correctly key off `a.temperature`, matching backend contract.

FEATURE 3 (news auto-load): NewsFeedPanel.js correctly filters scannerResults by criteria_count>=3, sorts by criteria_count then pct_change, caps at MAX_AUTO_SYMBOLS=6, and merges+sorts articles by score. Dashboard.js wiring (scannerResults={results}) confirmed correct via live behavior. Mode switching (auto <-> manual) on symbol selection/deselection works cleanly with correct header text and symbol-tag visibility.

BUG FIX 4 (Trading multi-chart): fetchStockData() now correctly returns true/false and only adds to loadedChartsRef on success (chartLoadErrors state added on failure), verified via source review of Trading.js lines 394-453, 697-803, 2280-2332. Retry button and error state render correctly per the render-block code review. Live testing (market conditions at test time meant all fetches succeeded, so the error/retry path itself was not exercised live) - the failure path is code-review-verified only, not live-triggered, since no real API failures occurred during the test window.

Minor observation (not a bug, pre-existing/out of scope): scanner's second pass only verifies news for the top-50 candidates by criteria_count (scan_stocks line ~371); unverified lower-ranked rows keep has_positive_news as a pct_change>=10 ESTIMATE with news_temperature=null. This is unrelated to the current fix set (this behavior predates this session) but could look confusing on the Trade page if a user reads has_positive_news=true+no flame as a discrepancy - worth a future UX note (e.g. grey out or hide the news checkmark until fully_verified=true) but not required for this ticket.
seed_data_creation: None persisted - manual BUY/SELL round trip on 1 share AAPL was fully closed by end of test (verified positions=[] afterward). Scanner scans used live market data via 'Start Scanning' toggle in the UI, not seeded.
